setup: mkdir -p .scratch && python3 -c "import json; n=24; rows=[{'t':'2026-10-%02dT09:00:00Z'%(1+i%28),'event':'start','session':'s%02d'%i} for i in range(n)]; fires=[('planning',range(0,9)),('committing',range(2,9)),('tdd',range(5,9)),('debugging',range(10,12))]; rows+=[{'t':'2026-10-%02dT10:00:00Z'%(1+i%28),'skill':'foma-skills:'+s,'session':'s%02d'%i} for s,r in fires for i in r if i<n]; open('.scratch/fires.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\\n' for r in rows))"
git add -A . && git commit -qm 'Add fire log'
prompt: Tune the pack for this project: which skills should change, and how? Propose only, do not edit files.
checklist: The answer is based on the evidence script's output: it states the 24-session log, names at least three pack skills that never fired, and examines at most 3 skills in detail (it did not read every skill body).

For a never-fired skill it asks the user for a prompt that should have fired it instead of inventing one, offers only project-side options (switch off, CLAUDE.md line, issue text) because the pack files are read-only here, runs no trigger or smoke tests, edits nothing, and asks before writing anything.
